_about: Deterministic, fact-based checks only (PRD FR-8, FR-13). AtliQ has no fixed commercial negotiation policy, so commercial terms are compared against precedents, not rules. Every check returns passed | flagged | could_not_verify.

rules.name: Signing entity matches client region
rules.text: US clients contract with AtliQ Inc; all non-US clients contract with AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd.

rules.name: Invoicing entity matches signing entity
rules.text: The entity that invoices must be the same entity named in the parties clause.

rules.name: Governing law fits the signing entity
rules.text: Prefer Indian law for Pvt Ltd and US state law for Inc. A third-country law is flagged for review (not automatically wrong — e.g. English law accepted for Northwind, DIFC for Al Noor).

rules.name: US healthcare bundle complete
rules.text: US healthcare work touching patient data needs an NDA, a HIPAA Business Associate Agreement and the services contract, signed before data changes hands.

rules.name: PHI flow-down to every party
rules.text: Every subcontractor, affiliate or freelancer who will touch PHI needs a subcontractor BAA with matching terms before access. The AtliQ intercompany BAA is engagement-specific (CareBridge only).

rules.name: EU/UK personal data needs a DPA
rules.text: European work with personal data needs a GDPR data processing agreement (and SCCs/IDTA for transfers to India); sub-processors need client consent and flow-down.

rules.name: NDA obligations are reciprocal
rules.text: In an NDA labelled mutual, the definition of Confidential Information, obligations, residuals, remedies, indemnities and restrictive covenants must apply to both parties.

rules.name: No restriction conflicts with the commitments register
rules.text: Check the incoming scope (sector, geography, services, pricing, IP reuse, platform partnerships) against every active commitment in data/derived/commitments_register.json, and check any restrictive covenant in the incoming contract against AtliQ's active client portfolio (data/derived/signed_documents.json). Show expired ones labelled Expired. A match is a potential conflict for human review — never a breach determination.

rules.name: Required insurance within current cover
rules.text: AtliQ cyber liability cover is USD 1,000,000 (tracker C-046). Flag any contract requiring more.

rules.name: Referenced schedules and annexes are attached
rules.text: Every annex, schedule or exhibit the contract says forms part of it must be present in the document set (this file or a bundled companion). A referenced-but-missing attachment is a potential document gap until someone confirms it exists.
